titleEn: Law on the Approval of Second Protocol Amending the Treaty of Amity and Cooperation in Southeast Asia of Manila on 25 July 1998

articles.en:
To approve the Second Protocol Amending the Treaty of Amity and Cooperation in Southeast Asia, done at Manila on 25 July 1998,
the text of which is annexed hereto.
The Royal Government of the Kingdom of Cambodia shall take all necessary measures to implement this Protocol.

This Law is declared to be urgent.
Done at Phnom Penh, 26 January 1999, and respectfully submitted for the Royal signature; Prime Minister, signature; submitted to Samdech the Prime Minister; Minister of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation, Hun Sen; No. [illegible]; certified true copy; Minister of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation, signature, [illegible] 1999.
The Second Protocol Amending the Treaty of Amity and Cooperation in Southeast Asia, Manila, 25 July 1998.
The Governments of Brunei Darussalam, the Kingdom of Cambodia, the Republic of Indonesia, the Lao People's Democratic Republic, Malaysia, the Union of Myanmar, the Republic of the Philippines, the Republic of Singapore, the Kingdom of Thailand, the Socialist Republic of Vietnam and the Government of [illegible], hereinafter referred to as the High Contracting Parties:
Considering that paragraph 5 of the preamble of the Treaty of Amity and Cooperation in Southeast Asia, done at Bali on 24 February 1976 (hereinafter referred to as the Treaty of Amity), provides for the requirement of cooperation with all peace-loving nations, both within and outside Southeast Asia, in order to promote peace, harmony and [illegible] in the world.
Article 18, paragraph 3 of the Treaty of Amity is hereby amended to read as follows: states outside Southeast Asia may also accede to this Treaty, provided that
the consent of all the states in Southeast Asia, namely Brunei Darussalam, the Kingdom of Cambodia, the
Republic of Indonesia, the Lao People's Democratic Republic, Malaysia, the Union of Myanmar, the Republic of the Philippines, the Republic of Singapore, the Kingdom of Thailand and the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, is obtained.
Article [illegible]: This Protocol shall be subject to ratification and shall enter into force on the date on which the instruments of ratification of all the High Contracting Parties have been deposited. Done at Manila, 25 July 1998.
For Brunei Darussalam: Prince Mohamed Bolkiah, Minister of Foreign Affairs
For the Kingdom of Cambodia: Chem Widhya, Special Envoy of the Royal Government of Cambodia; For the Republic of Indonesia: Ali Alatas,
